description: Source code for ASN.1 handling related to XNAP private information elements, including class methods for encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a choice between local and global private IE IDs with methods for setting, encoding, decoding, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 sequence representing a private IE field with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for ASN.1 container item holding a private IE ID, criticality, and value, with methods for packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c to global type.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Encodes the private_ie_id_c into bit stream.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Decodes the private_ie_id_c from bit stream.
